text:
Trevor Connelly, 20, is making the jump look easy. The 2024 first-round pick (19th overall) has 7 goals and 16 points in his first 25 NHL games, plays 14.7 minutes a night, and with him on the ice at 5v5 Vegas has 60.1% of the expected goals.

The context makes it stand out. Of the 105 forwards picked 14th to 24th since 2005 with four-plus seasons, the median in their first season of 20-plus games was 0.36 points a game. He is at 0.64. Nothing about it looks lucky: 7 goals on 6.8 expected, 12.5% shooting, and Vegas has actually scored 4.5 fewer goals than the chances deserve with him out there.

He is fast, too, with a top speed in the 99th percentile of NHL Edge tracking. Jesse Granger of The Athletic called his setup of William Karlsson against Dallas on Nov. 17 "a spectacular play," a shot fake that got Jake Oettinger to bite. Two nights later he scored in the shootout against the Stars.

His last ten games: 7 points against 6 expected, with goals in the first three games of November and four assists since.
